FROM
t JOIN public.nocode_biz_directory_binding rd ON rd.object_id = #{objectId} AND rd.record_id = t.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(base.keyColumn)}::text AND rd.detail_id = '' AND rd.row_id = '' AND rd.field_id = '' AND rd.deleted = 0 JOIN public.nocode_biz_attachment_binding ab ON ab.object_id = #{objectId} AND ab.record_id = t.${@com.richuang.os.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(base.keyColumn)}::text AND ab.deleted = 0 AND ab.state = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (ab.detail_id = '' AND ab.field_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{visibleFields} AS jsonb)))) OR (ab.detail_id <> '' AND ab.detail_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{visibleDetails} AS jsonb)))) )

sql.foreach:
AND
CASE WHEN split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{_group.level}) = '' THEN '' ELSE md5(split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{_group.level})) END
split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{_group.level})
= #{_group.key}

choose.when: CASE WHEN split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{directoryLevel}) = '' THEN '' ELSE md5(split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{directoryLevel})) END

mapper.select:
SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'ruleVersion', rd.rule_version, 'fileCount', count(*), 'totalSize', COALESCE(sum(ab.file_size), 0), 'recordCount', count(DISTINCT ab.record_id) )::text
GROUP BY rd.rule_version ORDER BY rd.rule_version DESC

SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT 1
GROUP BY split_part(rd.group_keys, '|', #{directoryLevel}) ) x

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'kind', x.kind, 'nodeId', x.node_id, 'fileCount', x.file_count, 'totalSize', x.total_size )::text FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN ab.detail_id = '' THEN 'FIELD' ELSE 'REGION' END AS kind, CASE WHEN ab.detail_id = '' THEN ab.field_id ELSE ab.detail_id END AS node_id, count(*) AS file_count, COALESCE(sum(ab.file_size), 0) AS total_size
AND ab.record_id = #{recordId} GROUP BY 1, 2 ) x ORDER BY x.kind, x.node_id
SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'fileCount', count(*), 'totalSize', COALESCE(sum(ab.file_size), 0), 'recordCount', count(DISTINCT ab.record_id) )::text
SELECT DISTINCT object_id FROM public.nocode_biz_directory_binding WHERE deleted = 0 AND detail_id = '' AND row_id = '' AND field_id = '' ORDER BY object_id
